name: AI Harness Assistant
description: Checks the coding harnesses installed on your machines — Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, OpenCode, Cursor and the like — and brings versions up to date. Assumes you already run these tools; it maintains what is there rather than advising on what to adopt.

official.title: AI Harness Assistant by Alan
official.description: Keep your computers current on AI coding harnesses you already use (Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, OpenCode, Cursor, and similar). Update installed...
